verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any official SDK or client library: the docs items cover payments and card-issuing features. The probes only show an llms.txt file and no OpenAPI spec, and an llms.txt is an adjacent signal for AI readers, not an SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
